title: Feelings Wheel — Atherio
source_supported_observations: The public page presents a three-ring wheel.
The wheel is directly manipulable by drag and flick gestures.
High-energy spinning can enter a broken/shattered state.
A Repair action reassembles the wheel.
The surrounding product language emphasizes a quiet check-in rather than a feed or streak scoreboard.
